subject: PR #1051 — native-build attestation (DR-057): readiness (b) 20/20 from the Mac; review + merge, then the Mac re-mints on mainline
body:
PR #1051 (mac/native-build-attestation) closes the "5% gap": readiness dimension (b) was capped at 19/20 on the only machine that may mint evidence, because `Build (all packages)` and `Browser E2E (review console, website, admin)` are structurally excluded on arm64 macOS and the E2E step is a launch binding.

What it does (DR-057, appended after DR-055 — DR-054 rides #1019, DR-056 rides #1031; do not take DR-057 elsewhere): the Mac's amd64 Linux VM (Apple container, node:22) now runs the two steps CI runs on Linux — `scripts/mac/linux-web-build.sh --e2e --attest <path>` — and `scripts/verify-all.mjs --vm-native-build` records them ONLY from an attestation bound fail-closed to this tree: schema + status exact, treeSha == HEAD at mint, tree clean on the host BEFORE the VM launched (untracked included) AND clean at mint, steps ⊆ the registered needsNativeBuild names; the attested step gets the same recomputed sourceDigest as a native run plus `attestedBy`. New pure lib `scripts/lib/native-build-attestation.mjs` (self-test 15/15, registered in preflight and mirrored in CI, parity 418 gates 0 unwired). The `evidence` sim operation carries the flag, so your re-mint requests and the DR-056 objective loop get the full figure without anyone typing it. Dimension (b) counts nothing new; nothing changes what may be claimed to ship.

Measured: VM trial `53 passed (1.9m)`, `e2e exit=0 in 121s`; full preflight on the branch `Preflight PASSED — everything it runs is green` (358 ok, 0 failed). First `--vm-native-build` mint on the branch HEAD f2d1a459: VM `53 passed (1.7m)`, `attestation written … (tree f2d1a459…, clean=true)`; emitter `native-build attestation: Browser E2E (review console, website, admin) + Build (all packages) attested from the VM run`, `preflightCoverage.stepsNotRun: []`, `nativeBuildAttestation: {treeSha f2d1a459…, ranAt 2026-09-25T16:11:35Z, runner apple-container/amd64/node:22}`, `verify-all exit=0`; `node scripts/check-readiness-figure.mjs` → `(b) launch surface, evidence 100% — 20/20 bound proofs/steps current`, `HEADLINE 100% → OUTREACH OPEN`. The minted mac-run.json is NOT on the branch (it names a sha a squash-merge would orphan); the backlog row closes with this output in a follow-up commit on the branch.

Shared surfaces (rule 2): one appended row each in `scripts/preflight.mjs` and `.github/workflows/review-hub-ci.yml` beside the NaN gate (#1019 appends to the same files — both are appends, union-mergeable); DR-057 appended at the tail of DECISION_RECORDS.md.

Ask: review + merge #1051 (owner-gated: scripts/**, CI workflow, DECISION_RECORDS.md). After it lands, the Mac re-mints on mainline with the flag and commits mac-run.json there (bound to the mainline sha, never this branch's) — expect readiness 100% then. Nothing here waits on the owner.
